chunks.content: ## Learning through a simple cycle A fictional mini-lesson for testing retrieval of uploaded course materials. This document makes no claim about teaching effectiveness. ## Text retrieval control The text control marker is KLICKER-PDF-TEXT-731. The learning-cycle diagram is on physical page 2. Use Figure 1 when explaining the relationship between its three stages. ## Questions to ask the chatbot 1. Which page contains the learning-cycle diagram? 2. Show Figure 1 and explain its three stages. 3. What color is the return arrow, and where does it point? 4. Read the visual-only marker printed inside the diagram. The visual-only marker and arrow details are embedded in an image. They are deliberately absent from this PDF's selectable text layer. ## Figure 1: Learning cycle Follow the diagram from left to right, then examine the return arrow. Orange return a arrow: try the cycle again VISUAL-ONLY MARKER: ORANGE-OTTER-731 Figure 1. Original synthetic diagram for the course-material retrieval test. ![Image 1](synthetic-course-diagram_images/page-002-image-001.png) Figure 1 - A fictional t three-stage learning Cycle PRACTISE EXPLORE REFLECT Read one worked example Solve one new problem Explain the correction Orange return a arrow: try the cycle again VISUAL-ONLY MARKER: ORANGE-OTTER-731 The diagram, its labels, and its marker are one embedded raster image.
